verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ׀ לִבְנֵי־ קֹ֬רַח מִזְמֽוֹר׃ כָּֽל־ הָ֭עַמִּים תִּקְעוּ־ כָ֑ף הָרִ֥יעוּ לֵ֝אלֹהִ֗ים בְּק֣וֹל רִנָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ liḇ·nê- qō·raḥ miz·mō·wr kāl- hā·‘am·mîm tiq·‘ū- ḵāp̄ hā·rî·‘ū lê·lō·hîm bə·qō·wl rin·nāh
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Psalm of the sons of Korah Clap your hands all you peoples . . . shout unto God with a voice of triumph

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֣ה עֶלְי֣וֹן נוֹרָ֑א מֶ֥לֶךְ גָּ֝דוֹל עַל־ כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- Yah·weh ‘el·yō·wn nō·w·rā me·leḵ gā·ḏō·wl ‘al- kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: How awesome is the LORD Most High the great King over all the earth

verses.original: יַדְבֵּ֣ר עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתֵּ֑ינוּ וּ֝לְאֻמִּ֗ים תַּ֣חַת רַגְלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.literal: He subdues nations beneath us and peoples under our feet

verses.original: יִבְחַר־ לָ֥נוּ אֶת־ נַחֲלָתֵ֑נוּ אֶ֥ת גְּא֨וֹן יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֲשֶׁר־ אָהֵ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: yiḇ·ḥar- lā·nū ’eṯ- na·ḥă·lā·ṯê·nū ’eṯ gə·’ō·wn ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’ă·šer- ’ā·hêḇ se·lāh
verses.literal: He chooses our inheritance for us the pride of Jacob whom He loves Selah

verses.original: עָלָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים בִּתְרוּעָ֑ה יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה בְּק֣וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃
verses.literal: God has ascended amid shouts of joy the LORD with the sound of the horn

verses.original: זַמְּר֣וּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים זַמֵּ֑רוּ זַמְּר֖וּ לְמַלְכֵּ֣נוּ זַמֵּֽרוּ׃
verses.literal: Sing praises to God sing praises sing praises to our King sing praises

verses.original: כִּ֤י מֶ֖לֶךְ כָּל־ הָאָ֥רֶץ אֱלֹהִ֗ים זַמְּר֥וּ מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: kî me·leḵ kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ĕ·lō·hîm zam·mə·rū maś·kîl
verses.literal: For God is King of all the earth sing to Him a psalm of praise . . .

verses.original: מָלַ֣ךְ אֱ֭לֹהִים עַל־ גּוֹיִ֑ם אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים יָשַׁ֤ב׀ עַל־ כִּסֵּ֬א קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.literal: God reigns over the nations God is seated on His holy throne

verses.original: נְדִ֘יבֵ֤י עַמִּ֨ים׀ נֶאֱסָ֗פוּ עַם֮ אֱלֹהֵ֪י אַבְרָ֫הָ֥ם כִּ֣י לֵֽ֭אלֹהִים מָֽגִנֵּי־ אֶ֗רֶץ מְאֹ֣ד נַעֲלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: nə·ḏî·ḇê ‘am·mîm ne·’ĕ·sā·p̄ū ‘am ’ĕ·lō·hê ’aḇ·rā·hām kî lê·lō·hîm mā·ḡin·nê- ’e·reṣ mə·’ōḏ na·‘ă·lāh
verses.literal: The nobles of the nations have assembled as the people of the God of Abraham for the shields of the earth belong to God He is highly exalted
